Buffalo Supply
, Inc. distributes and supplies medical devices, surgical equipment, and specialized healthcare products from
major medical manufacturers
to federal agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the Department of Defense.
LinkedIn
Key Manufacturer Partners
STERIS
(longstanding 15-year partnership for infection prevention, surgical, and hospital equipment)
Smith+Nephew
(orthopedic portfolio including hip and knee implants, trauma, and extremity products)
Boston Scientific / AMS Men's Health
(urology and pelvic health devices, including AMS 700, Ambicor, Spectra, and AMS 800 urinary control systems)
Integra LifeSciences
(neurosurgery, wound care, and general surgery solutions)
LinkedIn
Product Categories Distributed
Orthopedic hardware, knee/hip implants, and reconstructive joints
Surgical instrumentation and craniotomy kits
Urology and male continence/restoration systems
Neurosurgery and advanced wound care items
Specialized hospital equipment and cryotherapy systems (such as TruFreeze)

is a medical device and surgical equipment distributor. Their primary manufacturer partner is
STERIS

Smith+Nephew
